attributes.companyShortDescription: Triend is a decentralised review tool that verifies and tokenises review and feedback data to improve experiences for travellers and business’s globally.
attributes.companyLongDescription:
Triend is a cutting-edge decentralized review tool that harnesses the power of immutable and verified review and feedback data to enhance the experiences of travelers and businesses worldwide. By focusing on key metrics such as sustainability, authenticity, and inclusivity, Triend equips businesses with unmatched insights into their customers' preferences. 


Triend provides an easy-to-integrate widget that travel providers can incorporate into their websites. This widget enables customers to leave reviews and feedback directly on the provider's website, eliminating the need for third-party platforms. 

**Customizable Surveys:** 
Businesses can personalize questions within the widget to gather more specific information about their customers' experiences. This customization helps businesses understand their target audience better and identify areas for improvement in their services. 

**Triend Portal:** 
Businesses gain access to the Triend portal, where they can monitor and analyze customer and staff feedback. The portal displays data based on trust standards such as authenticity, sustainability, inclusivity, and accessibility, providing valuable insights for the businesses. 

**Blockchain Technology:** 
Triend utilises blockchain technology to securely store and manage reviews, turning them into digital assets owned and monetized by contributors. This encourages users to contribute high-quality reviews, creating a gamified and rewarding ecosystem. 

**Reward Tokens:** 
Contributors are rewarded with tokens for their reviews, which can be spent on future travel, staking, or supporting sustainable causes. This incentive system further encourages user engagement and promotes a sense of community among users. It also differs from anything on the marker due the open transparency or getting rewarded for reviewing and answering specific questions that the business receives. No need for tricking to take data. 

**Data Analysis:** 
Triend's advanced analytics tools enable businesses to gather essential data from reviews, helping them identify trends, areas for improvement, and opportunities for growth. This tailored data analysis allows businesses to make informed decisions and fine-tune their operations.


In summary, Triend is a unique and innovative software solution that streamlines the review and feedback process for travel providers. By integrating the widget, customizing surveys, utilizing blockchain technology, and offering reward tokens, Triend enhances customer engagement, provides valuable insights for businesses, and creates a mutually beneficial ecosystem.

attributes.companyShortDescription: LZero is an enterprise-grade, modular, cloud-based platform that allows anyone to launch highly configurable, private testnets
attributes.companyLongDescription:
Today public testnets are the go-to solution for application development. BUT in their current form, public testnets are a substantial bottleneck to the development of the web3 ecosystem due to several key issues. They are not sufficient or complete as development & testing infrastructure. Public testnets often lack accurate or relevant mainnet data, have limited token supply, fragmented tooling, no privacy, and often get deprecated. And even then, it’s a massively expensive overhead for the core developers of public blockchain (e.g. Ethereum's Holesky needing 50 contributors and 10 months of work with $100k+ monthly running costs). 
These issues are more prominent for institutions & regulated entities that cannot compromise on privacy, cannot risk leaking IP, and even need to ensure the resilience of the underlying blockchain at all times. 

LZero offers the first testnets-as-a-service platform for blockchains, dApps and institutions. We’re building an enterprise-grade, modular, cloud-based platform that allows anyone to launch highly configurable, private testnets. LZero's management control plane can simulate realistic mainnet behaviours and critical risk management scenarios such as high congestion and network-level attacks. LZero’s cloud platform allows for scalability and intellectual property protection, while unlimited control over test tokens guarantees comprehensive testing of financial products for performance and security prior to launch. 

We will integrate the LZero platform with Camino Network Layer 1, including all network functionalities. Our platform will allow anyone to quickly set up and test arbitrary testnets under various configurations and network conditions. This simulation engine will be controlled by an intuitive UI that allows anyone to deploy or shut down testnets in a few clicks. Our cloud-based platform will allow these testnets to be deployed either on our cloud infrastructure, or any existing infrastructure that the client would like to use. 

The first use case is for the internal Camino Network dev teams themselves for testing and development. We aim to work closely with the Camino team to ensure that the platform is always maintained and up to date. However, the real power of LZero lies in its ability to onboard dApps and enterprises that build on top of Camino Network and become the devOps tool of choice for the entire ecosystem.

Our valued employees ensure that travel at home and abroad is a special experience. It is no coincidence that the new Group Headquarters in Vienna is called the “Home of Travel”: this is where the diverse range of products and services offered by the various brands are reflected and put together. 

**VERKEHRSBUERO TRAVEL**
The VEREKHRSBUERO TRAVEL division plays a leading role in the leisure tourism sector. Customers receive personal advice and service at our Ruefa travel stores throughout Austria, complemented by locations operated by Eurotours and Intertravel. A wide range of travel offers – from classic beach holidays to high-quality long-haul, cultural, and cruise trips – is, of course, also available online. As a tour operator, Eurotours International has established itself as a full-service provider in multi-channel sales across the DACH region and neighboring countries, securing a leading market position. It is also the largest provider of direct-to-consumer travel sales. The colleagues of the VERKEHRSBUERO TRAVEL division attest their competences with many years of experience in the organization of group and incentive travel, events and congresses (Austropa Interconvention). The colleagues of the DDSG Blue Danube provide special moments with their ships on trips through the Wachau and along the Vienna Danube Canal. 

**VERKEHRSBUERO HOSPITALITY**
The VERKEHRSBUERO HOSPITALITY division comprises 21 hotels operated under international franchise brands and as Austria Trend Hotels, serving as the ideal base for city and business travelers in Austria and Slovenia. The portfolio is completed by the Schloss Schönbrunn Grand Suite, two campsites, and a hostel in Vienna. The leading Austrian hotel group also offers event spaces for gatherings of all kinds. Palais Events operates the historic venues Palais Ferstel, Palais Daun-Kinsky, the Vienna Stock Exchange Halls, as well as the world-famous Café Central in Vienna’s city center.

attributes.companyShortDescription: BOGOWI is a new platform connecting travelers with authentic local experiences, attractions, and nature in the Canary Islands — and soon beyond. Through a network of BLE devices, mobile apps, and blockchain, BOGOWI rewards exploration and supports sustainable tourism. A portion of each ticket sale funds the BOGOWI Conservation DAO, where the community votes to support environmental projects. By merging real-world adventures with Web3 innovation, BOGOWI empowers conscious travel and brings value back to local ecosystems and communities.
attributes.companyLongDescription: BOGOWI’s mission is to transform tourism into a force for local empowerment and environmental sustainability through technology, community, and authentic experiences. BOGOWI is an innovation-driven tourism platform designed to promote authentic, sustainable travel. We connect visitors with local experiences and attractions through a mobile marketplace, while also encouraging exploration via a network of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices that gamify the travel experience. Our key services: A platform to book and promote local experiences (payment in € or crypto) A rewards system that fosters sustainable behaviors The BOGOWI Conservation DAO, which channels a % of revenues into environmental initiatives selected by the community. We aim to drive economic impact while supporting cultural and ecological preservation.

datakyte exists to make travel selling as simple as sharing a post.
We help tour operators, hotels, activity providers, and destination managers connect their bookings directly to social media, messenger chats, emails, and even AI assistants — with no complex tech setup or booking engines required.

Our technology turns any travel product into a smart booking link, called a KLINK, that works anywhere your audience sees you. With our Scroll-to-Book™ experience, travellers can go from discovery to payment in under 90 seconds without leaving the content that inspired them.

For the first time, content creators can also add these booking links directly to their videos, posts, or livestreams, allowing them to earn commission on bookings without leaving their platform. This makes datakyte the first travel technology designed for both operators and creators, working together to sell experiences.

We serve the entire travel industry: tours, stays, activities, cruises, car hire, and in-destination experiences. By hosting and structuring your inventory, we make it instantly shareable, AI-readable, and available across every channel you choose.

The result? More bookings, less admin, and the freedom to focus on delivering unforgettable travel experiences.
